notes.title: Content Update #2 - Story Mode, Asynchronous Multiplayer
notes.notes:
The second major content update 'Story Mode' is [b]out now for ZOMBETES! [/b]

[b]New Gameplay Mode: Story[/b]
- Three new curated levels that continue the narrative. 

[b]Asynchronous Multiplayer Features[/b]
- Find and loot the bodies of players that have died in ZOMBETES
- Use 'POSTPADS' to write messages for other players to find in the world

[b]Performance Optimizations [/b]
- Drastically reduced CPU usage
- Status window updates much quicker
- Text posts faster

[b]Perpetual Mode Updates[/b]
- Add 'Third Eye' upgrade; JOURNAL reveals items in unlit rooms
- Add 'Prestige' upgrade; resets upgrades, increases Prestige level

[b]UX Improvements[/b]
- Better recognition of written items & rooms.
- Autoscroll more consistently

[b]Balance Updates[/b]
- Chance of missing attacks globally reduced
- 'Thrown' items always break (50% chance to distract NPC increased from 25%) 
- NPCs can always be dodged; warn the player of risk when attempting to do so

[b]General Updates[/b]
- JOURNAL now displays items in visited rooms
- Added 'carjack' mini game when using any ignition item that is not a CAR KEY in a vehicle
- Added skill points when reading BOOKS that improve chance of successful travel or rest
- Limit 'status' checks to 10 when no CGM is equipped

[b]New item : KEVLAR[/b]
- Saves player from receiving damage in any context where they are attacked

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
- 'Shoot' command checks if user wrote a specific weapon to shoot with instead of autoselecting
- 'Kill' command no longer displays a weapon as a viable choice if it has no ammo

[i]ZOMBETES is currently in Early Access and scheduled for full release at the end of summer 2025.[/i]

[i]Join the ZOMBETES Discord server to take part in the community, offer feedback, and/or report bugs. 
We take into consideration all feedback for future updates.[/i]

notes.title: Hotfix - Perpetual Mode - Fix infinite carb loop with the Honeymooner perk
notes.notes: Fixed an issue that caused the Honeymooner perk to erroneously increase blood sugar continuously when ingesting food items with an odd number of carbs.

notes.title: Early Access v1.13 - Early Game Balance, QoL updates, Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
This update is aimed at improving first impressions of the game; preventing overly-challenging experiences from occurring early on, and adding 'Quality of Life' updates along with some other bug fixes.

[list]
[*] Added early game balancing in Normal mode:
[i]- Clamp level sizes until surviving over 3 days
- Hostile encounters increase progressively until max spawn rate at 10 days survived[/i]
[*] Improve application 'Fullscreen' behaviour at launch
[*] Prevent player 'favorite food' from matching non-food items in the items dictionary
[*] Fix crash when using 'GAME CONTROLLER' item on an NPC
[*] Fix ammo not properly depleting when shooting NPCs with a gun
[*] Prevent 'take' from sound playing when no items were actually taken
[*] Minor improvements to tutorialization tips
[*] Added more NPC dialog
[/list]

notes.title: Fixed 'Readables' crash and barricade command logic
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed crash when loading a level after having read a LETTER or BOOK
[*] Improved auto-using barricade items when simply typing 'barricade'
[/list]

notes.title: Content Update #1 - Perpetual Mode
notes.notes:
The first major content update 'Perpetual Mode' is out now for ZOMBETES!

[b]New Gameplay Feature: Perpetual Mode[/b]
[list]
[*] Roguelite mode where progress is retained after death
[*] Earn currency by surviving the night, defeating foes, and curing infections or wounds
[*] Spend currency in the 'After-Life' store to gain permanent buffs that will improve your survivability
[*] Progress is auto-saved and can be continued when restarting the game (cloud saves supported)
[/list]
[i]Access 'Perpetual Mode' by typing 'I am alive' when prompted to 'Wake up'.[/i]

[b]New Command: 'Drive'[/b]
[list]
[*] Vehicles can now be used to 'drive' to the next level
[*] Requires using GASOLINE and an item for the ignition (e.g. SCREWDRIVER)
[*] Can no longer 'rest' in vehicles
[/list]
[b]Context Window Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] The 'Context Window' can now be resized, and the ASCII image will scale with it
[*] Added new ASCII imagery for humans, animals, animal zombies, commands, and items
[*] Updated ASCII imagery for some zombies and the 'look' command
[*] Added image 'wiggle' when attacking a foe
[/list]
[b]General Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Added more areas and items
[*] 'Useless' items (e.g. 'POOL NOODLE') will now distract hostile NPCs
[*] Added more NPC conversations
[*] Items given from NPCs in conversation are no longer strictly predetermined
[*] Human NPCs may now give hints to find important items in a level
[*] Added chance for predetermined items to spawn in some rooms
[*] Less likely for level generation logic to select the same areas twice in a row
[*] Added more 'book' and 'letter' contents
[/list]
[b]Command Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] 'Continue' command room selection improved to more reliably cycle through all areas in a level
[*] 'Read' command can now be used on its own to automatically 'read' a readable item within a room 
[*] 'Attack' command flow improved
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Context Window revealing the NPC when entering a darkened area
[*] Fixed issues with 'barricade' command not selecting the correct type when multiple barricade types are present within an area
[*] Fixed inability to read books after having read a single book
[/list]

notes.title: First major update coming September 30
notes.notes:
ZOMBETES has been in Early Access for a few weeks now, and development hasn’t slowed down!

Our [b]first major update[/b] is coming on [b]September 30[/b], focusing on significant improvements to the ASCII display and the introduction of a new roguelike mode: [b]Perpetual Mode[/b]. In Perpetual Mode, players can earn and spend cash across multiple lives, enhancing their survivability through each run.

The ASCII updates will improve how images are displayed for better consistency, and you’ll now be able to resize the window to scale images dynamically, providing a more immersive experience. Overall, the context window will now better reflect the action taking place in your journey.

[i]With development ongoing, you can expect monthly content updates like this until the full release, planned for 2025. 

Stay tuned- and join our Discord server to offer your feedback and help influence the game![/i]

notes.title: ZOMBETES out now!
notes.notes:
You can now pick up the game- try it out, join our discord, let us know what you think! 

In its current state, you can expect a full experience with: 

- A tutorial level to get you started 
- Procedural levels built using over 100 locations and items
- Interactable NPCs
- Automated travel logging so you can easily share your journey with other players 
- 25 minutes of original music produced by Meat Analogue 

Development will continue over the coming months. Come share your feedback and help shape the experience!
